description: This file contains Makefile definitions and build rules for creating firmware images for Netgear devices, including scripts for creating root filesystems and squashfs images, as well as device-specific image configurations.

methods.name: Build/netgear-rootfs
methods.description: Defines a build step to create a Netgear root filesystem image using mkimage and concatenation.

methods.name: Build/netgear-squashfs
methods.description: Defines a build step to create a compressed squashfs image for Netgear devices, including compression, padding, and final image creation.

methods.name: Device/netgear_generic
methods.description: Configures device-specific build parameters for Netgear devices, including kernel images and firmware image packaging.
